name: Operations
description: Represents the collection of operations defined for an Entity object.
remarks: Use the Operations property of the Entity object to return the collection of operations for an entity.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: The Item property returns a specific member of a collection either by position or by index. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Use the Count property to determine the number of items in a specified collection. Read-only Long.
